reserve_identity.title: SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Item 1.05 material cybersecurity incident disclosures

why_retained.commercial_reuse: The SEC states that Government-created sec.gov content and EDGAR public filing content are free to access and reuse.
why_retained.stable_regulatory_identity: Release 33-11216 and Form 8-K Item 1.05 define a versioned material-cybersecurity-incident disclosure channel with structured-data requirements.
why_retained.possible_future_role: A separately authorized study could evaluate material-incident regulatory disclosure behavior or provide commercially reusable contextual evidence without claiming all-incident coverage.

hard_limitations: Item 1.05 is triggered only after a registrant determines that a cybersecurity incident is material.
Absence of a filing cannot establish a zero-incident organization-period.
Nonmaterial incidents are outside the mandatory Item 1.05 channel, and delayed disclosure is possible.
Filings and amendments are not a canonical count of all incidents.
A complete realized-loss amount is not required.
The reserve cannot independently clear OPT-014's full organization-period data gate.
future_activation_preconditions: Freeze an exact EDGAR form, filing-item, issuer-population, compliance-window, and acquisition-date contract before any filing or issuer data is read.
Freeze amendment, duplicate, delayed-disclosure, foreign-private-issuer, smaller-reporting-company, and compliance-transition handling before outcome inspection.
Use a claim boundary limited to material regulatory disclosures; do not treat non-filing issuer-periods as observed zeros.
Reverify exact reuse terms and any third-party content exceptions at the future acquisition date.
Require a separate network, data-volume, record-minimization, retention, and commercial-product-use authorization.
Keep the reserve independent from the Advisen-derived prior or freeze deterministic overlap exclusion before evaluation.
bounded_interpretation: This note keeps SEC/EDGAR visible as a reversible, commercially reusable, structurally limited reserve. It does not reopen active OPT-014 source work, select or acquire SEC data, establish a valid zero-period denominator, or clear the OPT-014 data gate.
